_description: Outcome spine: the minimum daily snapshot per account. When two snapshots exist with different as_of dates, delta = current - prior. Until then, show coverage/freshness only — do NOT simulate trends.
_status: DRAFT — first baseline snapshot exists; not yet eligible for trend reporting until a second compatible snapshot is validated

snapshot_contract.trigger: Rose query after TX fee process completes (Tuesdays) or on demand
snapshot_contract.as_of: ISO date of the data cutoff (e.g., 2026-07-30)
snapshot_contract.source_authority: Each displayed metric maps to exactly one source definition and period. No fallback blending.

source_aliases.note: Source-system IDs are aliases; company_id remains the canonical join key.

sell_penetration_denominator.note: numerator is annualized koronet_sell for short periods

field_evidence_contract.missing_value_rule: A missing or blocked field is null with a reason. It is never rendered as zero.
field_evidence_contract.period_rule: Numerator, denominator, channel split and associated buyer/order counts must share the same population and period. If they do not, the downstream interpretation is blocked.
field_evidence_contract.identity_rule: All source values resolve through company_id plus an explicit source alias map; normalized name matching may identify a candidate but cannot silently establish identity.

delta_rules.requirement: Two snapshots with different as_of dates required. Until then, delta = null.
delta_rules.display: Show coverage + freshness. Do NOT simulate delta from period comparisons baked into one snapshot.
delta_rules.honest_label: When showing pre-computed MoM/QoQ/YoY from a single Snowflake query (current state), label as 'period comparison' not 'daily change'.
